summary: Comprehensive backend testing of DigiWallet V2 API. 43/43 pytest tests passed covering auth (register/login/me/change-password/brute-force lockout), wallet summary, transactions, external /api/credit (invalid/paused/duplicate/success), payment methods (UPI), withdrawals (create/list/insufficient), notifications, and all admin endpoints (dashboard, users CRUD, login-as, force-logout, wallet credit/debit/adjust/freeze/reverse, withdrawals approve/reject/paid/bulk/export, api-keys CRUD + toggle, api-logs, broadcast, security logs/sessions, settings, telegram test, 403 for non-admin).

minor.issue: today_activity & api_requests_today use `{'$gte': today}` where today is a date ISO string (YYYY-MM-DD) but created_at is full ISO datetime string (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00). String comparison still works as a prefix-lex compare so it functions correctly today, but is fragile if timezones/formats change.
When passing a non-existent user_id PATCH /api/admin/users/{id} silently returns 200 even though update_one matched nothing (no 404).
Pydantic AdminCreditReq/AdminDebitReq use Field(gt=0); negative/zero returns 422 (not the 400 some clients may expect). Cosmetic only.
Accepts empty ids array and returns 200 with processed=[]; no validation that ids is non-empty.

Returns new_balance computed from in-memory user.get('balance')+amount rather than re-reading after $inc; safe today (sequential awaited update) but should be re-fetched to be 100% accurate under race conditions.

action_items: (Optional) PATCH /api/admin/users/{id} should return 404 when user_id does not exist (currently 200).
(Optional) Recompute today's range using ISO datetime instead of date string in dashboard aggregations for robustness.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1042 lines and mixes routes, schemas, helpers, startup, and aggregation logic in a single file. Recommend splitting into modules (auth.py, wallet.py, admin.py, schemas.py, db.py) once features stabilize.
JWT_SECRET is committed in /app/backend/.env. For production this must be moved to a real secret manager. Acceptable for dev.
ACCESS_TTL_MIN = 60*24 (1 day). Consider shorter-lived access tokens + refresh flow; /auth/login already mentions REFRESH_TTL_DAYS but no refresh route is implemented.
/api/credit logs the api_key (full body.model_dump()) into db.api_logs. Sensitive keys should be masked before storage (currently telegram_send masks to 8 chars but log keeps full key).
Brute-force lockout key is `ip:mobile`; an attacker rotating IPs (or behind NAT impacting many users) can bypass. Consider also per-mobile lockout independent of IP.
settings.smtp_password is masked on GET but never validated on PATCH; any unauthenticated XSS-like leak of settings panel could expose this. Should be write-only.
Cookies set with samesite='lax' and not 'secure=True' — should be secure when behind HTTPS (which it is in preview).
test_credentials: Admin: 9999999999 / Admin@123 (verified). Test users created dynamically with TEST_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: Tests create temporary users (random mobile starting with 7), one UPI payment method, several credit/debit/adjust transactions, and one withdrawal (approved+paid). Data is left in DB but prefixed/identifiable; not affecting seeded admin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints listed in review_request are passing. Frontend testing was NOT requested in this iteration. The default API key is fetched via GET /api/admin/api-keys[0].key. Brute-force lockout uses ip:mobile composite. Reject of withdrawal correctly refunds balance (verified). Test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is a full regression suite ready for reuse.
rca of the issue: Only one test initially failed (test_register_password_mismatch returned 422 instead of 400). RCA: the test payload used full_name='X' (1 char) which fails Pydantic min_length=2 validation BEFORE reaching the password-mismatch check. Fixed by using a valid full_name. No backend code change required.
